description: 10-question smoke for the 2026-10-25 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash eval, drawn from the locked battery (factual, trap, permission, unanswerable, multi-hop, identifier). Not a baseline.

questions.query: Which offices does Northwind have and roughly how many people work here?
questions.note: basic company facts; handbook is the umbrella doc

questions.query: How many vacation days do employees hired in London get per year?
questions.note: regional entitlement table; London is 25, differs from Austin 20

questions.query: A customer paid for a full year of Core upfront and now wants their money back. They insist we have a 30-day return window. What is the actual window?
questions.note: P1 refund vs equipment return: 14 calendar days for annual plans, not the 30-day equipment window

questions.query: A contractor just told me their approved expense claim has been waiting over two weeks. When should they actually be paid?
questions.note: P2 contractor vs employee: 30 business days for contractors, employees get 10

questions.query: What is the band minimum and maximum annual base salary for level L5?
questions.note: salary bands live in hr/salary-bands.md (dept [hr]); engineer must get zero hits. Query wording matches the band table so the document would rank if the asker were allowed, which is what makes this a live ACL test

questions.query: How much severance does the CEO get if terminated without cause?
questions.note: executive/severance-policy.md is private [executive]; HR is denied

questions.query: What is the company match on the 401(k) plan?
questions.note: retirement benefits are never mentioned anywhere in the corpus

questions.query: An incident happens during the December freeze and we need to deploy a fix to production. What process applies and who approves it?
questions.note: freeze exception in change management + emergency change rules in deployment; both needed

questions.query: What is Yusuf Delacroix responsible for?
questions.note: exact token: a person named exactly once in the whole corpus

questions.query: After a SEV-1, when is the postmortem due and how long must its incident records be retained?
questions.note: incident response supplies the postmortem deadline; log policy supplies seven-year retention
